title: Voice Note Mak Long
mood: cheeky, exasperated and laughing at the family
subject: a family WhatsApp group where an aunt sends a four-minute voice note every morning before the subuh alarm
caption: Hipdut, the 2025 Malaysian hip-hop and dangdut fusion. A kendang dangdut hand drum playing the tak-dut groove with crisp slaps; a bamboo suling flute answering each line with short bent phrases; a boom-bap drum machine with a dry snare and a soft kick; a round electric bass walking under the kendang; a nylon dangdut guitar playing quick tremolo fills. Dry and punchy mix, kendang and lead voice forward, a short slap delay on the suling. Male voice, mid register, rapping the verses in a relaxed conversational flow and singing the chorus with a light dangdut cengkok bend. 98 BPM, A minor. Cheeky, exasperated, laughing at the family. No trap 808 slides, no autotune, no EDM drop, no koplo double-time, no rock guitar, no gospel choir.
lyrics:
[Intro - kendang groove and suling]

[Verse 1]
Pukul lima pagi telefon aku bergetar
Group Keluarga Besar, Mak Long dah mula bersuara
Empat minit suara, ayam berkokok kat belakang
Pasal harga gula, pasal anak jiran yang hilang

[Pre-Chorus]
Aku tekan play, separuh mata terbuka
Dia sebut nama aku, adoi, apa pula?

[Chorus]
Voice note Mak Long, belum subuh dah sampai
Satu kampung dengar, aku pun tak boleh lari
Laju dua kali pun masih panjang lagi
Voice note Mak Long, selamat pagi

[Verse 2]
Petang tu dia tanya kenapa aku tak balas
Blue tick dua, Mak Long, saya bukan tak ikhlas
Pak Ngah hantar sticker kucing menangis tiga kali
Sepupu kat Johor tukar nama group lagi

[Pre-Chorus]
Malam aku rakam satu, panjang lima minit
Mak Long balas satu emoji, ibu jari je

[Chorus]
Voice note Mak Long, belum subuh dah sampai
Satu kampung dengar, aku pun tak boleh lari
Esok aku bangun dulu, aku yang mula hari
Voice note anak saudara, selamat pagi

[Outro - suling and kendang alone]
Mak Long, saya dah bangun
Ayam pun belum bangun
